guidelines.title: Community guidelines
guidelines.intro: Living Dose Community is a supportive space. These guidelines keep it safe and kind for everyone.

items.b: Everyone is on their own journey. Encourage, don't judge. No bullying, hate or harassment.

Talk about what has worked for you, but don't tell others to start, stop or change medicines. Only verified professionals give clinical guidance here, and even then it's general: your own doctor knows you best.
Don't post phone numbers, addresses, email addresses or anyone else's personal details. Use anonymous posting in Mind and wellbeing.
No adverts, product promotion, "miracle cures" or links to buy things.
If someone seems to be in danger, report the post so our team can help. If you are in crisis yourself, call 112 or go to the nearest hospital.
Our moderators review reports and may remove posts or suspend accounts that break these guidelines.
